room_purge.panel_subtitle: Erase an archived room and its content from this server. This cannot be undone.
room_purge.no_archived_rooms: There are no archived rooms eligible for permanent deletion.
room_purge.irreversible_body: The room will disappear for everyone and cannot be restored from the active server.
room_purge.removes_messages: All messages and encrypted message bodies
room_purge.removes_files_calls: Attachments, media derivatives, and call state
room_purge.removes_access: Memberships, bans, room permissions, and read state
room_purge.backup_notice: Existing backups are not rewritten. Restoring an older backup may require the purge to be run again.
room_purge.confirmation_label: Type the room name to confirm
room_purge.confirmation_description: Enter {room} exactly, including capitalization and punctuation.
room_purge.local_cleanup_error: The server deletion completed, but encrypted offline data could not be cleared on this device. Retry before closing.
room_purge.error_authentication_unavailable: Authentication could not be verified. Try again shortly.
room_purge.error_forbidden: Only a server owner can permanently delete archived rooms.
room_purge.error_confirmation_mismatch: The room name did not match exactly.
room_purge.error_room_not_archived: Archive this room before deleting it permanently.
room_purge.error_purge_in_progress: A permanent deletion is already running for this room.
room_purge.error_purge_not_quiescent: The room changed during deletion. Towk stopped safely; retry to finish.
room_purge.error_timed_out: The deletion timed out. Retry to resume safely.
room_purge.error_interrupted: The deletion was interrupted. Retry to resume safely.
room_purge.error_invalid_response: The server returned an invalid deletion response.
room_purge.error_network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and retry.
room_purge.error_internal: The room could not be deleted permanently. No other room was modified.
